description: Publish a DRAFT election in the connected account, running every check the publish button runs (ballot, schedule, voter list, state law, price) and charging the price from the account's prepaid balance or plan. Free elections (up to 25 voters) publish at no cost. If the balance does not cover it, nothing is charged and the person pays by card at the finish link instead. Publishing does NOT send invitations: the organizer sends them from the election page. Confirm with the person before calling this; it can spend their money.

election.description: The election's id or slug, from list_elections or create_election_draft.

name: publish_election
title: Publish a draft election
